subject: Brooks Elementary School Welcome
overview: Principal Shannon Demos provides an overview of Brooks Elementary School's student demographics, specialized educational programs, and the school's core values.

items.title: School Overview and Student Population
items.summary: Principal Shannon Demos introduces the Brooks Elementary School, which serves approximately 520 students from pre-K to grade 5 with a staff of 88.

items.title: Specialized Classrooms and Curriculum
items.summary: The principal details the school's specialized offerings, including MEEP preschool, language-based classrooms, and specialist programs in art, music, and technology.

items.title: Educational Philosophy and Responsive Classroom
items.summary: The school utilizes a Responsive Classroom model to foster a safe learning environment and emphasizes the 'Brooks Bees' values of being kind, safe, and responsible.

items.title: Communication and Principal's Background
items.summary: Demos shares her 29-year history in education, including her start as a Medford paraprofessional, and encourages parent collaboration through frequent communication.
